title: specanchor comparison-policy v1
description: The parity comparison contract. The known-differences register is what makes parity honest: demanding a byte-exact match produces a gate that gets bypassed within two weeks. Naive equality is forbidden.

excluded_fields.description: Timestamps, sequences, generated identifiers — normalised away by scrubbers.

rounding.description: Expected rounding mode per field group, e.g. { "commission": "half-up" }.

field.description: The output field this accepted deviation covers. Without it the register is prose; with it the parity comparator can apply the acceptance mechanically.

known_differences.description: Every deliberate deviation from legacy behaviour, business-approved and dated. A silent difference is a defect; a recorded one is a decision.
